# MM-P3-L4-HT02 - Maintenance manual - Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2
Revision: Rev F  
Plant: P3, line P3-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-HT02  
This revision supersedes Rev E.

Scope
This document provides maintenance procedures for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02). It covers preventive maintenance actions, verification steps after repair, and required records for the heat treat process critical to metallurgical integrity. The procedures herein apply to EQ-P3-L4-HT02 located on line P3-L4 and are intended for qualified maintenance technicians and furnace operators. Related documents: ECN-2026-001, SOP-P3-L4-02, SOP-P3-L4-05.

Background and rationale
The heat treat furnace is used to achieve required metallurgical phases before downstream operations. Correct furnace control and sensor accuracy are essential to ensure repeatable results and to avoid scrap or rework. The austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 885 °C. Sensor drift or control element degradation can shift achieved temperatures away from setpoint; therefore, planned checks and calibration are required. Thermocouple performance affects temperature control and records; the thermocouple calibration interval for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 130 days.

Tools and materials
Use only calibrated electrical test equipment and documented calibration sources. Typical tools include insulated hand tools, appropriate personal protective equipment for high-temperature work, furnace door lift aids as installed by plant, replacement thermocouple assemblies specified in maintenance spares, and data capture devices compatible with plant historian. Consult SOP-P3-L4-02 and SOP-P3-L4-05 for personal protective equipment and lockout-tagout steps.

Procedure
Overview
Perform preventive maintenance and verification during scheduled downtime only. Follow plant lockout-tagout procedures before accessing furnace internal components. Refer to ECN-2026-001 for approved engineering changes before performing mechanical modifications.

Pre-maintenance verification
Confirm that the furnace is at ambient condition and isolated from electrical and gas supplies per SOP-P3-L4-02. Verify that the operator log indicates no active cycles. Ensure that data logging for the last run is archived and stored with maintenance records.

Thermocouple verification and calibration
Inspect thermocouple sheath and connection points for mechanical damage and contamination. If visible damage is found, replace the thermocouple assembly using the spare specified by maintenance spares and document the replacement. Calibrate thermocouples against a traceable reference. The thermocouple calibration interval for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 130 days. Record raw calibration readings and correction factors in the maintenance log and in the furnace sensor calibration record.

Control loop check and setpoint verification
With the furnace isolated and safe to operate per SOP-P3-L4-05, power the control system to diagnostic mode. Verify that control outputs respond to command changes and that actual temperature readback corresponds to simulated inputs. Confirm that the control system maintains the austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 885 °C. If the control loop does not track as expected, troubleshoot actuator elements and sensors; document corrective actions and reference ECN-2026-001 if hardware changes are required.

Element and refractory inspection
Inspect heating elements for physical integrity and refractory for spalling or cracks. Document any defects and replace according to approved parts lists. After element replacement, verify resistance continuity and confirm that installation does not obstruct thermocouple placement.

Post-maintenance verification
Restore power and control functions following SOP-P3-L4-02. Run a controlled heat up to verify stable control and data capture. Compare recorded temperature profile against the expected profile with particular attention to the austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 885 °C. Validate that thermocouple corrections applied from the latest calibration produce accurate process records.

Acceptance criteria
Equipment acceptance is based on a combination of documented inspections, successful function checks, and calibration records. Acceptance requires the following:
- No visible mechanical defects or electrical hazards remain following maintenance.
- Thermocouple calibration records demonstrate that corrections have been applied and are traceable to plant calibration standards; thermocouple maintenance meets the thermocouple calibration interval for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 130 days.
- Control system is capable of maintaining and recording the austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 885 °C during verification runs.
- All deviations found during maintenance have documented corrective actions and have been signed off by authorized maintenance personnel.

Records and example entries
Maintain a maintenance folder for EQ-P3-L4-HT02 that contains the following records and example entries:
- Work order with a brief description of actions performed and a reference to this document id MM-P3-L4-HT02.
- Thermocouple calibration certificate showing before and after readings and the date of calibration; include traceability to plant calibration standards.
- Control loop test log with simulated input values and actual output responses; include corrective action notes if adjustments were required.
- Refractory and heating element inspection report with photographs of defects and replacement part serials where applicable.
- Final verification report showing that the austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 885 °C was achieved and recorded.

Examples and notes
Example entries in the thermocouple record should include raw measured values, applied offsets, and a note stating that calibration meets the thermocouple calibration interval for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 130 days. Example control loop logs should show the commanded output and the measured temperature trace demonstrating stable control around the austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 885 °C.

References
ECN-2026-001
SOP-P3-L4-02
SOP-P3-L4-05

Revision history
Rev F — supersedes Rev E.
